missing_hlg_evaluation.rationale: Voting result 3/3 for NO_MISSING_HIGH_LEVEL_GOALS. The project description outlines responsibilities for Suppliers, Administrators, Warehouse Staff, Customers, Customer Support Agents, Managers, and Store Clerks. All explicit functional requirements are covered by the current High-Level Goals. Specifically: Supplier proposal management is covered by 'Manage Product Proposals'; Administrator evaluation and configuration are covered by 'Effectively evaluate supplier proposals' and 'Maintain optimal system configuration'; Warehouse inventory, verification, and replenishment are covered by 'Manage Warehouse Inventory' and 'Ensure timely stock replenishment'; Customer online purchasing, payment, and delivery tracking are covered by 'Complete the online product purchase process', 'Securely complete payments', and 'Accurately track order deliveries'; Customer support ticket management is covered by 'Efficiently manage customer support requests' and 'Manage Customer Support Tickets'; Manager analytics are covered by 'Gain comprehensive business insights' and 'Make informed strategic decisions'; and Store Clerk in-store purchases and payments are covered by 'Efficiently process in-store purchases' and 'Accurately handle in-store payments'. The retired HLGs (e.g., 'Accurately verify incoming goods', 'Ensure timely resolution of customer issues') are semantically entailed by the broader current HLGs ('Manage Warehouse Inventory' and 'Manage Customer Support Tickets' respectively). No distinct actor-level outcomes are missing.
